about: Model provider metadata for guided setup and navigation (ADR 0103). Kept outside core/ so core/ remains model-free and vendor-free (ci/model-free.sh, ci/vendor-free.sh).

replay.label: Local replay (L0, zero API key)
replay.budget_guidance: Free: replays recorded L0 responses with zero token or USD spend.

gemini.label: Google Gemini
gemini.budget_guidance: Free tier in AI Studio (250 req/day cap) or paid $0.75/M input, $0.075/M cached, $3.75/M output (profiles/prices.json); set SPEND_BUDGET_TICKET_USD and SPEND_BUDGET_DAY_USD in policy/rework.env.

anthropic.label: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.budget_guidance: Paid per run: $2.00/M input, $0.10/M cached, $10.00/M output (profiles/prices.json); set SPEND_BUDGET_TICKET_USD and SPEND_BUDGET_DAY_USD in policy/rework.env.

openai.budget_guidance: Paid per run: $2.00/M input, $0.10/M cached, $10.00/M output (profiles/prices.json); set SPEND_BUDGET_TICKET_USD and SPEND_BUDGET_DAY_USD in policy/rework.env.
